paragraphs.text: An International Learning Environment. A World of Opportunities.
A shared partnership between school, students and families
High standards, modern campus infrastructure and a holistic commitment to every learner.
Thank you for being an essential part of the Target International School family. Our school is founded on a clear mission: nurturing confident, capable, and principled global thinkers.
We combine internationally accredited Cambridge standards with holistic pastoral care, rigorous STEM education, and personalized university preparation.
Target International School Campus & Academic Community
A connected educational journey from foundational skills to elite global qualifications.
Grades 1–7: English, Mathematics, Sciences, Computing foundations & critical inquiry
Grades 8–9: Rigorous subject specialization, external assessments & lab research
Grades 10–11: Advanced subject mastery accepted by leading worldwide universities
Planned 2027: Dual-diploma opportunities, practical portfolios & Australian track
Continuous Alignment: All pathways follow official Cambridge standards and are taught by certified subject specialists.
Specialisation from Grades 8–9: Science vs Economics
Targeted academic pathways aligned with student strengths and long-term university goals.
Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology & Vibecoding. Focus on laboratory inquiry, quantitative reasoning, and engineering design. Destination: Top STEM & Medical faculties.
Economics, Business Studies, Accounting, Statistics & Global Trade. Focus on financial analysis, business case competitions, and market strategy. Destination: Top Business & Law schools.
Hands-on experimental verification, coding prototypes, scientific method defense, and algorithmic simulations in modern lab facilities.
Analyzing real global corporate cases, financial statement modeling, startup simulations, and developing professional negotiation skills.
Diagnostic Selection: Guided by academic diagnostic scores, psychologist evaluations, and individual family admissions roadmaps.
A comprehensive pre-university ecosystem ensuring competitive worldwide admissions.
Target Band 7.5–8.5+: Weekly full-length mock exams, Task 1 & 2 academic essays, and speaking interview coaching.
Target 1450–1550+: Mastery of adaptive digital Math modules, Reading & Writing analysis, and speed strategies.
Pre-university research paper defense, formal essay argumentation, citation standards, and critical thinking.
Common App, UCAS & global portals: personal statement workshops, activity list refinement, and recommendations.
Olympiad medals, student council leadership, published research, and community service initiatives.
Dedicated high-focus study pods, supervised evening revision hours, peer bootcamps, and 1-on-1 mentor support.
Admissions Commitment: 100% of our Grade 10–11 students receive personalized academic profiling and tailored university roadmap plans.
Cambridge-endorsed textbooks, hybrid courseware and cutting-edge digital learning platforms.
Official Cambridge University Press and Hodder Education endorsed textbooks across Mathematics, Sciences, Business and English.
Custom school-curated packs connecting Cambridge standards with national curriculum mastery, including bilingual glossaries.
Topic-by-topic 10-year past paper question banks, official Cambridge mark schemes, and weekly revision workbooks.
School LMS portal, virtual science simulations, coding playgrounds, automated diagnostic quizzes, and homework tracking.
Resource Guarantee: Every student receives official printed coursebooks and verified portal credentials at the start of term.
How Target International School systematically monitors teaching delivery and drives continuous improvement.
Where implemented, lessons are digitally recorded to evaluate explanation clarity, student talk time, and lesson pacing.
Academic leadership conducts regular unannounced evaluations using international rubrics: active engagement and differentiation.
Real-time weekly tracking of curriculum milestones guarantees no Cambridge learning objectives are omitted or rushed.
Bi-weekly teacher pedagogical workshops, Cambridge assessment webinars, modern pedagogy circles, and peer observations.
Pedagogical Support: Monitoring is not punitive — it provides leadership with clear diagnostic data to support every teacher.
Integrating modern educational technology, student safety and responsible classroom analytics.
HD safety cameras and 4K interactive touch smartboards in every classroom enabling active multimedia inquiry.
Monitoring student focus, participation patterns, and quickly identifying learners needing additional support.
Camera and audio data are strictly confidential, protected under governance, and restricted to authorized leaders.
All educational technology serves one primary purpose: student physical safety, academic growth, and targeted care.
Dedicated subject specialists holding advanced international qualifications and pedagogical experience.
Master's in Linguistics • IELTS Examiners • Focus: Academic writing and analytical debate.
M.S. in Applied Mathematics • Olympiad Trainers • Focus: Problem solving and lab research.
B.S. in Software Engineering • AI Mentors • Focus: Python, algorithm design & robotics.
Our Students' Achievements: Past, Present & Future
Celebrating verified competition victories, ongoing academic growth and upcoming horizons.
National Olympiad medals in Math and Sciences; top percentile rankings in Cambridge Checkpoint diagnostic exams.
100% Term 1 syllabus completion, 92%+ homework submission consistency, and active coding hackathon participation.
SASMO, Kangaroo Math, AMC registrations confirmed; World Scholar's Cup teams entering regional and global rounds.
We celebrate not only top scores, but also determination, character growth, and personal improvement across all grades.
A continuous cycle balancing rigorous academic mastery with student psychological wellbeing.
Emotional wellbeing, adaptation, school belonging, and stress level evaluation
Core subject formative diagnostics: testing concept retention and problem solving
Classroom focus, study discipline, peer collaboration, and resilience check
Comprehensive unit progress review, Cambridge question styles & parent report
Early Intervention Advantage: The alternating 4-week cycle catches learning gaps or emotional hurdles within days, before termly exams.
Standardized examination administration, secure moderation and comprehensive analytics reporting.
Official Examination Window: 20th–30th of the designated examination month.
Standardized Cambridge testing protocols overseen by Cambridge Exam Officer.
Individual academic diagnostic dashboards generated with topic-level gap analysis.
Parent consultations and personalized academic support plans scheduled post-exam.
Empowering students to challenge themselves against top national and international peers.
SASMO, American Math Competitions (AMC 8/10), and Kangaroo Math with weekly training clubs.
International Physics, Chemistry & Biology Olympiads, experimental design fairs, and environmental symposiums.
Team debate, collaborative essay writing, and multidisciplinary scholar's bowl in regional and global rounds.
Target Vibecoding hackathons, robotics challenges, and software application showcases building real engineering portfolios.
Mentorship Plan: Dedicated after-school coaching squads ensure every registered candidate is thoroughly prepared.
Nurturing leadership, creativity, team spirit and social responsibility beyond academic lessons.
Academic Opening Assembly, Teachers' Day Gala, Autumn Sports Tournament, and Quarter 1 Science Fair.
Robotics & Vibecoding Studio, MUN, Debate Society, Chess Academy, Drama, and Football & Basketball teams.
Winter Gala & Charity Concert, Parent Open Classroom Days, Target Science Fair, and Annual Sports Olympiad.
Extracurricular participation builds communication, empathy, public speaking and leadership essential for elite universities.
Personalized psychological care, academic mentorship and strategic university admissions roadmaps.
Confidential 1-on-1 counseling, exam anxiety workshops, emotional regulation, and positive study habits coaching.
Personalized university guidance starting from Grade 8: US, UK (UCAS), Europe, Australia, and Asia requirements.
Strategic testing roadmap for IELTS, SAT, and A-Levels starting in Grade 10 to prevent burnout and maximize scores.
One-on-one personal statement editing, extracurricular resume building, interview practice, and recommendations.
Admissions Commitment: We guide every family through university application deadlines, requirements, and scholarship criteria.
Wholesome, balanced meals prepared daily under strict hygiene and dietary standards.
Warm whole-grain porridges, boiled farm eggs, fresh cottage cheese, baked whole-wheat bread, butter, and tea.
Nutrient-rich soups, lean meats (beef/poultry/fish), complex carbs (rice, buckwheat, puree), fresh salads, and compote.
Seasonal fruits (apples, pears, bananas), light baked pastries, kefir, natural yogurt, and herbal infusions.
Certified sanitary standards, daily food sample preservation, and individual attention to student allergies and dietary needs.
A secure campus environment, proud dress code and shared standards of mutual respect.
Biometric access turnstiles, 24/7 security guard patrol, full HD CCTV coverage, and nurse on duty.
Target navy blazers, formal shirts, tailored trousers/skirts fostering equality and school pride.
Morning line-up at 08:50, phone-free academic lessons, mutual respect, and academic integrity.
Safe & Respectful Culture: Target International School maintains a disciplined and caring atmosphere.
"Every child has potential. Our responsibility is to recognise it, develop it and prepare every student for a successful future."
Thank you for your trust, dedication and active partnership with Target International School.
